column1: # How the farm's old-layout view is assembled from this repo.

#   files  a real farm directory holding one link per file under the repo
#          path, recursively; files claimed by a more specific row are skipped

# supplied by both repos) is checked against the farm paths this produces and

# src/sourcesharp/{public,common}, flat in src/shared/native. One `file` row
# each, so nothing else of src/shared/native is linked into those farm
# directories (and the game/shared `files` row above skips these five).
# our files at Valve-tree paths (native/sdk mirrors the Valve tree)
